_comment: Tier-2 for kratos.mpm pitfalls #2 and #3: MATERIAL_POINTS_PER_ELEMENT is mandatory, lives in the MATERIALS json (properties[i].Material.Variables, not ProjectParameters), and its value must come from a per-geometry allowed set. Executed 2026-08-07 on Kratos 10.4.3 Release with MPMApplication. The fixture writes its own two-mdpa deck -- a 1x2 column of quadrilateral background-grid cells with one MPMUpdatedLagrangian2D4N body element in the top cell -- so it depends on no data files, and drives MpmAnalysis.Initialize() three times. Measured: value 1 initialises; omitting the key raises RuntimeError 'Error: "MATERIAL_POINTS_PER_ELEMENT" is not specified in Properties' from material_point_generator_utility; value 5 raises 'Error: The input number of MATERIAL_POINTS_PER_ELEMENT (5) is not available for Quadrilateral elements' + 'Available options are: 1, 4, 9, 16 and 25.'. The allowed sets differ per grid geometry and were read back from the installed libKratosMPMCore: Triangular 1/3/4/6/12, Quadrilateral 1/4/9/16/25, Tetrahedral 1/4/8/14/24, Hexahedral 1/8/27/64/125. VERSION SENSITIVITY, stated because it changes the observable: Kratos master after this release downgrades both of these to warnings that silently clamp to the geometry default, so on a newer build the same mistake produces a wrong material-point count instead of an error. This fixture pins the INSTALLED build's behaviour and will need re-verification against a newer wheel. INTERPRETER: needs a Kratos build carrying MPMApplication; set KRATOS_PYTHON. MUTATION CONTROL (T2_MUTATE=1, re-runnable): the mutation INVERTS all three expectations -- 1 must fail, omission and 5 must succeed -- leaving the MpmAnalysis invocation untouched. Verified: unmutated PASSES (rc=0) with material_point_count_mismatches=0; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS (rc=1), the count goes to 3 and all three accepted[...]_expected=... lines flip. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/mpm_material_points_per_element_is_required && $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 $KRATOS_PYTHON source.py (fails).
expect_in_output: is not available for Quadrilateral elements
